title: This GitHub Skill Turns Claude Code Into an SEO Expert
description:
Someone in China put a SEO skill on GitHub that plugs straight into Claude Code or Codex 🔥

It turns your agent into an seo specialist: it figures out why a page isnt indexed and digs into traffic drops on its own. Best part, it also checks if ChatGPT Search and Google AI Overviews can actually see your site, not just Google ✨

It's called qiaomu-seo.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
